tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Lead | Java, Spring & OCC APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven expertise in Java, Spring, micro-services and OCC REST APIs, combined with hands-on PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, CI/CD pipelines and production support. Strong techno-functional consulting: requirements analysis, user stories, stakeholder management and AI-assisted development. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer ready to lead complex e-commerce projects.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Lead
cover_en.hook: I am excited about Evorait’s vision to drive next-generation e-commerce platforms. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have consistently delivered scalable, AI-enhanced solutions. I am eager to bring my technical depth and leadership to your innovative team.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I guided junior developers, performed code reviews and translated business requirements into robust SAP Commerce solutions, ensuring alignment across international stakeholders.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented end-to-end Hybris 2211 features for product, catalog and pricing, leveraging Java, Spring and OCC APIs, delivering high-performance e-commerce experiences.

bullets.label: Integration & API Design
bullets.text: Built PIM-to-Hybris pipelines (Profisee, DataHub) and OCC REST services, resolving complex ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks and enabling seamless data flow.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & CI/CD
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, utilized Docker/Kubernetes and collaborated in Scrum teams to accelerate releases while maintaining quality.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Lead
cover_de.hook: Die Innovationskraft von Evorait im Bereich moderner E-Commerce-Plattformen begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in SAP Commerce Cloud bei Rockwell Automation und Shell habe ich skalierbare, KI-unterstützte Lösungen erfolgreich umgesetzt. Gerne bringe ich meine technische Expertise und Führungsstärke in Ihr Team ein.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Führung
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich Junior-Entwickler angeleitet, Code-Reviews durchgeführt und Geschäftsanforderungen in robuste SAP-Commerce-Lösungen übersetzt, stets im internationalen Kontext.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Expertise
bullets.text: Entwickelte und implementierte End-to-End-Funktionen in Hybris 2211 für Produkt-, Katalog- und Preismanagement unter Nutzung von Java, Spring und OCC-APIs.

bullets.label: Integration & API-Design
bullets.text: Erstellte PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines (Profisee, DataHub) und OCC-REST-Services, löste komplexe ERP/MDM-Integrationsprobleme und ermöglichte nahtlose Datenflüsse.

bullets.label: Agile Lieferung & CI/CD
bullets.text: Führte CI/CD-Deployments auf CCv2 durch, nutzte Docker/Kubernetes und arbeitete in Scrum-Teams, um Releases schnell und qualitativ hochwertig bereitzustellen.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich bis zum 15.12.2026 in der Kündigungsfrist, frühester Eintritt 16.12.2026. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: Evorait’s commitment to pioneering AI-driven e-commerce solutions aligns perfectly with my experience in AI-assisted development and SAP Commerce Cloud integrations. I admire your focus on scalable, customer-centric platforms and see an opportunity to leverage my technical leadership to accelerate your product roadmap and deliver measurable business value.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Evorait to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud leadership and AI-enhanced integration expertise to shape cutting-edge e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years’ experience at Rockwell and Shell. I’m interested in the Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Lead role at Evorait and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Lead – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Lead position. I bring over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience, proven leadership, and a strong track record of delivering integrated e-commerce solutions. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for your team.

Best regards,
